description: This Java source file defines the UrlLoader class, a resource loader that loads resources from URLs. It provides methods to get a URL from a location string and to load an InputStream from that URL, handling exceptions related to URL syntax and IO errors.

classes.name: UrlLoader
classes.description: A class that extends ResourceLoader to load resources from URLs, implementing methods to obtain a URL from a string and to open an InputStream from that URL.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Converts a location string into a URL object, handling URI syntax exceptions and malformed URL exceptions.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Loads an InputStream from the URL obtained from the location string, handling IOExceptions.
